decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The LB of Hounslow as the LPA hereby certify that on 19/1/06     
   the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a   
   garage and storage/ gym at rear garden of the house measuring   
   a depth of  6.8m by 3.8m high by 8m and set in 1.7m from the 
   entrance gates .would  have been lawful within  the meaning of  
   Sections 191 and 192 of the Town and  Country  Planning Act 1990, 
   (as amended), for the following  reason: 
   The proposed development would fall within Class E,   
    Part 1, Schedule 2 of  The Town and Country Planning (General    
    Permitted Development)  Order, 1995. 
             
             Informative
              The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be   
             used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyme

Condition : 2 - Informative
The detached outbuiding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single family dwellinghouse known as 832 Great West Road and for no other purpose, (ie it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a garage / storage to rear garden to house
